purpose: CPU latency and output-equivalence of request-scoped tool catalog index reuse, not new retrieval quality scoring. Closed ToolRet query set is never loaded by this driver.

corpus.provenance: examples/toolret-protocol.json pinned web corpus, reused solely as workload; source text is not redistributed
corpus.boundary: prepare_routing_workload.py exports only tool metadata to fresh tools-only JSON; driver never receives query labels. catalog_<index> namespaces duplicate names; original name retained in description and exact field routing document. Legacy schemas serialized for workload only; never executed. Non-object/array/null legacy parameters are preserved under x-catalog-parameters in an inert object schema; original parameter JSON remains in routing document. All rows retained; adapter correction follows pre-timing assertion failure, not observed performance.

queries: read customer invoice and refund policy
variants: core6 routeTools with bounded per-instance lexical cache
order: Pass0 uncached then cache; Pass1 cache then uncached; first cached call is cold; all per-call samples retained
measurements: exact full ranking score/name/schema equality per query
all wall-ms samples and median/p95 descriptions
process RSS and CPU in guarded phase report
outcome_rule: No speedup threshold; retain losses. Correctness requires exact ranking and execution object references. Do not tune cache sizes/query text after observing timing.
scope: New system performance diagnostic; no repeated old101 quality scores, no API studies reopened.
